download_wizard_of_wikipedia_model: download the pretrained wizard of wikipedia end2end generative model to a specified datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch end2end_generator_0.tar.gz from the wizard_of_wikipedia model repository
review_download_function: review the download function that uses parlai core build_data to fetch pretrained models
